summary: Built sweepStaleVerdicts() in daemon.js, mirroring sweepStaleClaims. Detects tasks with overlay.status 'tested'|'ready' whose owner isn't live (no running agent) AND lastChanged past stale_minutes (reused, default 10). Surfaces each by enqueuing ONE overlayStore.addGuidance item — exact POST /guidance shape {question,context,trigger:'repeated_failure'} — tagged verdictKey for per-key idempotency; halts loops like the gate. NEVER mutates status (no tested→done). Pure predicate staleVerdictKeys(overlay,agents,nowMs) exported + unit-tested. Wired into decideAll() right after sweepStaleLoops(), runs on the 60s heartbeat. node --check clean; full suite 21 files green (self-heal 18/18). Edited via /tmp+cp; round-trip verified.
